top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clock) is the mature, independently reproduced case with the cleanest two-name allocation. The magic-wavelength trap is a new physical idea, not a refinement of the comb or single-ion work, and it made the clock a probe of gravitational redshift and of constants. The citation should name the magic-wavelength concept and leave the redefinition of the second out. P002 (magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene) is the stronger case on novelty, but it is younger and its experimental credit is incomplete. An award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: As WACQT director and a superconducting-circuits theorist I know the circuit QED groups and the 2025 laureates, but B004 is not on the slate. No connection to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer is apparent from the profile.
